name: Gold (fear gauge)
summary: Gold near $3,620 on 23 Nov, 6.3% lower on the week and 22% lower over three months; weekly fall now inside the 7% line
state: Gold futures were near $3,620 early on 23 Nov, 6.3% lower on the week, 22% lower over three months and about a third below the 52-week high (Yahoo Finance). The weekly fall has eased from 8.8% on 20 Nov to inside the 7% single-week Alert line, leaving the three-month fall of more than 8% in the Watch band. The decline has come as the dollar index rose to near its 52-week high (Yahoo Finance).
for_you: Gold prices are swinging sharply, which affects the value of gold holdings and jewellery. Safe-haven demand is not showing the usual rise during the equity sell-off.
rubric_hit: 3m fall 22% > 8% = Watch; 1w move -6.3% inside the 7% Alert line
why: Gold is the oldest crisis hedge; disorderly surges signal fear about currencies, inflation or geopolitics.
drivers: Real interest rates, central-bank buying, geopolitical fear, dollar moves.

rubric.alert: 3-month gain > 20%, or a single-week move > 7% either way.
